what: City of Vancouver, Washington (Clark County) sidewalk centrelines, public view layer; the sidewalk layer for scripts/corner_labels.py --sidewalk-presence (issue #169)
item_description: A view layer based on sidewalks feature data from Clark County GIS and transportation updated weekly. Any personally identifiable information has been removed from this view.
publisher: City of Vancouver, WA (CityOfVancouverGISAdmin); accessInformation: Clark County GIS

query_note: all features intersecting the bbox of runs/vancouver/area.geojson (the bbox inventory.json used), outSR 4326, all fields, paged by resultOffset ordered by OBJECTID; OBJECTIDs asserted unique. Layer total at download: 75,352.
keep_note: STATUS 'NA' (28,203) carries no UNITTYPE (attached/detached) in all but 14 features, and is read as a street side digitized WITHOUT a sidewalk, as 'NA' with no RAMPTYPE is read in the curb-ramp layer (corner-inventory amendment A6). RMV (removed), CONST (under construction), Clarify and null are not counted as sidewalk either. Chosen before any build with the layer; see docs/corner-labels-169.md.
